WELCOME TO YOUR KINGDOM

You build it. They bonk it.

Keep Frederik's castle safe from a very silly zombie invasion!

  1. 1
    Build a brilliant defense

    Choose one of eight buildings, then click the meadow. Your first two archer towers and six wooden walls are a gift!

  2. 2
    Let the towers do their thing

    Start a wave. Archers shoot arrows, fire splashes groups, and ice slows zombies. You can keep building during the attack.

  3. 3
    Collect, improve, repeat

    Zombies drop coins. Survive a wave for a bonus, 30 coins per mine, and 8 castle health. Each wave gets trickier!

Moats & drawbridges

Moats slow zombies to 35% speed and never break. Drawbridges include water below them. Choose the Bridge tool, then click a bridge to raise it into a wall or lower it into a crossing. Zombies can break raised bridges.

Remove buildings for a 50% refund. Switch to Creative Mode for unlimited building coins. Save and Load keep your kingdom in this browser, even during a wave. New kingdom keeps your existing save until you save again.

How will you play?

You can switch anytime. Your buildings and progress stay.

 A FRESH ADVENTURE

Build a new kingdom?

Your current battlefield will be reset. Your saved kingdom stays until you press Save again.

 BACK TO THE KINGDOM

Load your saved game?

This replaces your current battlefield with the kingdom saved in this browser.

Import this kingdom?

Your current battlefield will be replaced. Your browser save stays unchanged until you press Save. Export first to keep a backup.
